scope: Rendered img src, img/source srcset, inline style attribute/style element and directly linked local stylesheet url() values, and file-extension anchor href references in editorial pages and six landing pages. Excludes external stylesheet contents, nested CSS imports, CSS image-set string candidates, lazy data attributes, dynamically fetched app content and non-extension download endpoints. CSS URLs are candidates, not computed-style visibility evidence. Registry/file presence only; no R2 existence, external availability, byte integrity or visual certification.
